In PHP, foreach by value operates on a copy of the array (since PHP 7, foreach by value iterates over a copy of the array structure for arrays... actually the array's reference count is incremented and a copy-on-write copy is made). However, if the array contains objects, the objects are shared (handle), so modifying object properties is visible. Also, foreach by reference ($arr as &$v) operates on live array.
